This writ petition has been filed for the following relief :
To to call for the records relating to the impugned proceedings issued by the 2nd respondent in form 6 dated 23.09.2025 and quash the same as being illegal.

2. The case of the petitioner is that while he serving as the Secretary of Peykulam Primary Agricultural Co-operative Credit Society, enquiry has been conducted under Section 81 of the Tamil Nadu Co- operative Societies Act, 1983 for the period 2015-16.

notice under form 6, dated 23.09.2025 initiating confiscation proceedings on the same set of allegations, has been issued.
Challenging the same, the petitioner is before this Court.

3. Heard the learned counsels on either side.
4.
